role: subordinate correction-only implementation strategy for cmix_obias_memory_safe_parent_q0_v1; not a compression candidate
hypothesis: Large FXCM calloc-backed anonymous tables can retain identical bytes and access semantics in preallocated MAP_SHARED scratch files while fixed-cadence MADV_PAGEOUT permits clean or written-back cold pages to leave process RSS.

evidence_boundary.activation_requires: A terminal phase-attribution receipt must bind the parent high-water to eligible anonymous FXCM allocations and show enough reclaimable bytes to reach the engineering target.
evidence_boundary.no_inference: File backing, virtual size, or a lower sampled RSS at one checkpoint does not prove peak memory qualification.

backing_file_policy: Create one unique regular file per eligible allocation beneath the receipt-bound scratch directory.
Use openat with O_CREAT, O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW, O_CLOEXEC and mode 0600.
Reserve the complete rounded mapping length with posix_fallocate before mmap so later writes cannot SIGBUS from disk exhaustion.
Map PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE and MAP_SHARED at file offset zero.
Close the file descriptor after successful mmap; retain the mapping registry until source-bound release or process terminal.
A newly created and fully reserved file supplies calloc-equivalent zero bytes before first write.
alloc1 preserves its declared returned-pointer alignment and records both mapping base and aligned pointer.
No mapping address, file descriptor, filename, page residency, or pageout result may enter predictor state or probability calculations.
allocation_contract.failure_policy: Any open, allocation, truncation, reservation, mapping, alignment, registry, pageout, unmap, or cleanup failure terminates as infrastructure failure; fallback to anonymous allocation is forbidden in an authority-bearing run.

pageout_contract.operation: madvise(MADV_PAGEOUT) over every live eligible mapping
pageout_contract.cadence: At a source-bound byte boundary after each 1048576 modeled bytes and once after predictor initialization before the first coded byte.
pageout_contract.return_policy: Every call must return zero; unsupported kernels fail before candidate evidence begins.
pageout_contract.semantic_boundary: Page residency and page-fault timing may change; mapped bytes and all model-visible values must not.

cleanup_contract.normal_terminal: munmap every registered region and unlink every backing file in reverse allocation order
cleanup_contract.failure_terminal: retain a receipt-bound manifest and remove only files whose inode identity matches the registry

proof_ladder: Synthetic allocator semantics and zero/alignment identity with no codec authority.
250KB P/K integer-probability, coder, persistent-state, payload, archive, inverse, pageout, and cleanup identity.
1MB probability-identical replay with external cgroup and process-tree receipts.
10MB only if measured peak reduction projects past the engineering target without archive divergence.
Full 1G parent qualification only after opening and distant scope identity and runtime feasibility.
activation_requirements: selected execution host has no active exclusive_full1g lease
Arm B terminal evidence and irrevocable Gamma memory failure are preserved
phase-attribution and allocation-lifetime receipts identify eligible FXCM mappings
required reclaimable-byte lower bound reaches the engineering target
exact source revision, patch, compiler, linker, flags, runtime root, scratch filesystem, cgroup, and corpus are content-addressed
unsupported MADV_PAGEOUT is rejected before evidence collection
claim_boundary: Probability identity makes this a memory-compilation child, not a new compressor.
Any probability or archive difference creates a new parent candidate and restarts the archive ladder.
A passing cgroup cap does not substitute for process-tree RSS and per-process VmHWM receipts.
Disk-backed state, page faults, runtime, and cleanup are independently measured gates.
This strategy has zero Gamma compression and score credit.
